name: Muang Thai Insurance
verdict: Thai non-life insurer listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand as MTI; its largest owners are the Muang Thai Group Holding company and members of the Lamsam family, with Belgium's Ageas at 12.2%. Nothing found.
aliases: เมืองไทยประกันภัย
note: Main front-of-shirt sponsor of Port FC (its blue box and slogan prominent on the 2026-27 home shirt; per Football Kit Archive's sponsor history, on Port shirts since 2016). The Lamsam family also leads the club (president Photipong Lamsam) - sponsor note only. No court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against Muang Thai Insurance found.
